name: Yamashina Rin
source:
"Right... I'm gonna be the top maiden at this school. And I'm not letting anyone beat me to it!"

Likes: Kabuki
Talents: Sewing, martial arts, pretty much anything
Dislikes: The latest fashion trends (or rather, doesn't understand or care to understand them)
Favourite role: Omitsu in "Nozuki-Mura"

A kabuki actor from a young age, striving to be the most beautiful [i]onnagata[/i] of them all. In other words, a guy.

After suffering a broken nose on stage during a performance, he decided to transfer to an all-girls school in order to improve himself. Born and raised in a strict kabuki family, he has willingly lived his life as a woman; as a result, he is not very conscious of his own male-ness.

He's a bad liar, but a good smooth-talker, and will use whatever methods he can to get what he wants. But he's happy to cloak this behaviour of his in a gentle, [i]yamato nadeshiko[/i]-like facade.
